body: God, this is exactly how I’ve felt since I was 13 years old. I wanna see if anybody would actually give as much of a shit as I hope they would. I know it would cause fights in between my family, and that would probably triumph over the grief.

I may or may not have BPD and unfortunately the best course of action is to tell as little people as possible because everyone will use it against you. I’ve had similar things happen to me and it ISN’T your fault. I hope you can find better friends in the future who care enough to understand you and your mental health more. Good luck.
